changelog:
1.- Enemy on point counter fixed:
(can be disabled on client settings). Thanks to glorp

2.- Low ammo:
Integrated a visual low-ammo indicator that dynamically tracks the weapon's magazine state. When the remaining ammo drops below a customizable threshold (25% by default), the HUD ammunition text automatically turns red to prompt a reload. (can be disabled on client settings). Shoutout lombre.

3.- Clan Score Chart:
Introduced a new analytics module that automatically generates a beautiful, interactive bar chart inside the in-game Clan menu (can be disabled on client settings). Shoutout lombre too.

4.- Client verified clans now cant be disabled on client settings

5.- Menu Timer Fix:
The timer was appearing on the screen while playing the game or when opening other in-game menus, now it only shows in the main menu.

6.- CSS:
We completely scrapped the old static UI cleaner and built a brand-new, remote Custom CSS Selector directly into the client settings!

7.- Settings:
Implemented a new profile manager in the client settings. Users can now save their entire current Krunker game configuration (FOV, sensitivity, keybinds, etc.) as a custom profile. Selecting a profile automatically injects the saved settings into the game and reloads the client.

Game settings profiles are saved to Documents/opium/profiles.json, allowing for easy backups and manual sharing between users.

8.- External queue:
Updated the external matchmaking queue with a custom audio alert. When it finds a match, it plays the intro of the song "FE!N"
